## Outreach - Reply Sync
Hourly at :15. Finds replies, bounces and out-of-office mail on tracked threads.

- Reply → REPLIED, no more mail, Telegram alert
- Bounce → BOUNCED + Contacts.emailStatus = BOUNCED
- Out of office → thread paused (oooPauseDays)

The daily run repeats this right before planning, and re-checks each thread again right before sending.
